text:
maya: Heads up — terraform apply for infra/gh-networking is due in 30m. preflight failed (deploy-bot). Plan shows an unexpected deletion of a Route53 record. Do we abort the window or run an override?

devin: link to the plan output?

maya: Sharing the snippet I saw from `terraform plan` — looks like the record is marked for destroy:```
- aws_route53_record.www 
    id: "Z123_example_www" -> null
    zone_id: "Z123"
```

deploy-bot: PRE-MERGE CHECK: preflight-plan FAILED for run 2021719812345.
Reason: drift_detected (state != repo_plan). Applying is LOCKED until manual review.

aj: CI shows PR #412 merged ~2h ago touching `modules/dns/records.tf` — likely cause. I can revert the PR if we want to abort.

rachel: If the change was intentional we can pin the resource back, but safer to abort and escalate. Removing a WWW record could break production. :warning:

devin: Can we run a targeted apply on the dns module in staging first? run the same plan in staging to verify the deletion is real.

maya: Good call — I'll run `TF_ENV=staging terraform plan -target=module.dns` now and share artifacts.

(2m later) maya: Staging plan also shows removal of `aws_route53_record.www`. So it's reproducible.

ops-oncall: If we abort, we need to update release notes + notify support rotation. Also preserve the exact plan output for postmortem.

aj: My recommendation: do NOT run a blanket override. Two options: 1) Revert PR #412 and re-run preflight, 2) Manual targeted apply to recreate record if deletion was accidental. I can revert now and re-open a PR.

rachel: We should also ensure the deploy-bot lock state is tracked. If we revert, deploy-bot should allow apply to proceed in the same window.

maya: Revert sounds safest. aj, can you revert and then run `terraform plan` again? If plan shows no destroy, we proceed with the scheduled apply.

aj: Reverted PR #412 (link: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/413). Kicking off a new plan in CI.

deploy-bot: New preflight run queued (id 2021719812401). Waiting on CI plan result.

(5m later) deploy-bot: PRE-MERGE CHECK: preflight-plan PASSED. No drift detected. Lock released.

devin: Great. maya — proceed with normal window. Keep an eye on rollout for 30m.

maya: Proceeding with `terraform apply` now. Running in `--auto-approve` under deploy-bot orchestration.

deploy-bot: APPLY STARTED by maya (orchestrated). Tracking: apply/2021719812450.

(10m later) deploy-bot: APPLY COMPLETED. No resources destroyed besides intended updates.

rachel: Updated release notes and support doc with what happened and the rollback steps performed. Added a note about PR review checklist for dns changes.

ops-oncall: Marking incident follow-up: postmortem scheduled tomorrow. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

maya: Thanks everyone. Closing the thread.
